data.one_liner: Toolkit for building complex, high performance animations and 2D games with Flutter.
data.what_it_does: SpriteWidget provides a node-based graph system for rendering sprites, particle systems, and handling user input seamlessly within standard Flutter widgets. It supports image loading, texture atlases, motion tweens, sequences, constraints, and custom canvas drawing.
use_when: You want to build a 2D game or arcade-style application inside Flutter.
You need high-performance sprite rendering mixed with standard Flutter and Material widgets.
You require particle systems for effects like rain, smoke, or fire.
avoid_when: You are building a standard CRUD or enterprise app where standard UI layouts and widgets suffice.
strengths: Integrates smoothly with other Flutter and Material widgets.
Built-in motion management for tweens, sequences, and groups.
Includes particle systems and support for sprite sheets.
weaknesses: Imperative node-graph paradigm differs from Flutter's declarative widget tree.

alternatives.name: flame
alternatives.why_pick_it: A more comprehensive and actively maintained game engine for Flutter with built-in components, collision detection, and audio support.
